column1: # Curated: the makes of each country's car fleet, as Make:weight with an optional /trend (relative change per year). The weight is the make's share of new cars of model year 2025; the trend carries it back to older model years (weight x (1 + trend)^(year - 2025)). Rounded from national registration statistics, public sales rankings (ACEA, OICA, Focus2Move, national associations) and, for small markets, their import mix. A make keeps weight in a model year only if it sold a model there that year.
